citation.title: Neural network approximation of Bayesian models for the inference of ion and electron temperature profiles at W7-X
citation.authors: A Pavone, J Svensson, A Langenberg, U Höfel, S Kwak, N Pablant, R C Wolf, Wendelstein 7-X Team

topic: Fast NN surrogate of Bayesian XICS inversion to Ti/Te profiles at W7-X.
own_question: Can a CNN trained only on samples from a Minerva model's joint distribution approximate full Bayesian Ti/Te profile inference from XICS images?
actual_method_and_evidence: 500k synthetic 20x195 images were drawn from the prior plus a Gaussian likelihood. A LeNet-style CNN mapped them to 15-point profiles. Uncertainty came from a 10-member committee with Laplace weight posteriors. Testing used several OP1.1 shots against MCMC posterior means; agreement was shown in figures only, and some core Te mismatches fell within error bars. A k-NN distance check compared training-set priors (Table 2). Reported evaluation time was ~10 μs per point on one CPU, versus hours for MCMC. This is spatial inversion of a single frame, with no temporal or nowcasting component. Ti refers to argon impurity line widths, not CES carbon.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: NNs have been trained to approximate Bayesian spectrometer inversions, offering large speedups over MCMC profile inference at W7-X.
claim_checks.qualification: Speedup is evaluation time per frame; it is offline testing, not real-time deployment. The ion temperature is from argon XICS.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Distance-to-training-set checks can flag when measured inputs lie outside synthetic training coverage.
claim_checks.qualification: The paper shows one measured image and a single prior comparison. It is a heuristic, not validated novelty detection.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are a single binned XICS image per time point. Targets are synthetic profiles. No past-report inputs and no arrival times are involved.
validation_if_relevant: Synthetic test set from the same generator. Real-data comparison is to MCMC inference on several shots with a fixed magnetic configuration. No independent truth.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite as temporal nowcasting or CES work
Do not claim real-time deployment or KSTAR applicability
Do not claim quantitative agreement metrics beyond the figures
Do not equate argon XICS Ti with carbon CES Ti
Do not call the NN an online upstream reader in our pipeline
reason_to_include_or_exclude: A useful example of fast upstream NN spectrum/profile inversion with explicit uncertainty. It can frame upstream reading as distinct from our downstream nowcast.
